summary: Recorded host research of TAG baseline commit 94eef1c and one bounded decomposition of Improve TAG; replay fixture, not autonomous execution. All baseline file:line citations refer to that commit.

mutations.text: The baseline already provides persistent nodes, atomic graph mutations, prerequisite scheduling, bounded dispatch, and an external-agent context/apply workflow. Reuse these rather than replace the engine.

mutations.text: Make one researched decomposition visible before attempting autonomous implementation. A plan is not evidence that its work has been completed.
mutations.source: bootstrap.md:16-23 and the Improve TAG demonstration objective

mutations.objective: Turn an objective into one source-grounded decomposition
mutations.context: Reuse bounded dispatch and proposal validation. Read bounded TAG source excerpts with provenance, request one research-backed task graph, and stop before executing children. Acceptance: one inference attempt maximum; tasks remain pending; accounting and failure reasons are inspectable.

mutations.text: Dispatch already handles isolation, limits, and reservations, but exhausting a one-generation dispatch terminalizes the root. Planning needs a distinct successful stop that leaves proposed work open.

mutations.objective: Make the persistent graph readable without decoding JSON
mutations.context: Render the existing graph, not a separate UI state model. Acceptance: see hierarchy, prerequisites, runnable work, questions, rationale, evidence sources, and results in a terminal and a self-contained browser view.

mutations.text: The baseline CLI prints graph/status/inspect as JSON. The existing explain function already distinguishes runnable work, waiting children, and prerequisites.

mutations.objective: Make Improve TAG reproducible and honest about what ran
mutations.context: Acceptance: document fresh planning with credentials and an explicitly labelled offline recorded replay; test both with deterministic provider mocks; never present replay as fresh inference or a plan as implemented changes.

mutations.objective: What approval policy should govern future code execution?
mutations.context: A future iteration could apply proposed improvements, but tool permissions and human review policy have not been agreed. This question does not block the planning/viewing demonstration.

mutations.reason: Human decision needed before any future autonomous code-changing iteration; out of scope for this demonstration.
